gaps: The dataset is an 80/20 average: 'an average process from the chromic acid process in Tab. 44.3 and the information at EMPA from the former studies is established - with an amount of 80% chromic acid process'. Only the chromic acid column is printed; 'the respective information from EMPA is not shown here due to confidentiality reasons'. The extracted list is therefore the 80 % share only.

The EMPA share contributes chlorobenzene (modelled as benzene + chlorine at 95 % yield) and aluminium chloride (modelled as aluminium + chlorine at 95 % yield). No amounts are given, so those four inputs are NOT included here.
The sulphuric acid amount actually used is 'the stoechiometric value based on an efficiency of 95%', which the report does not print.
Electricity, steam, infrastructure and both transports are named by the report but carry no numbers; they are free parameters for calibration.
The air emissions are given as percentage rules applied to inputs the report itself replaces, so their absolute values are uncertain.
'Due to confidentiality reasons, only the cumulated data from this dataset are available for the user of ...' - the dataset's own unit-process table is not published.
